claims.text: The dark action anime TANK CHAIR begins October 4, 2026, with new broadcasts scheduled weekly.

TANK CHAIR premieres in Japan on October 4, 2026. TOKYO MX begins the series Sundays at 11:00 p.m. JST, with BS11 following at 12:30 a.m. Additional broadcasts begin on CBC October 5 and MBS October 6.

The main TOKYO MX broadcast is scheduled every Sunday at 11:00 p.m. JST. The official anime site says Prime Video begins advance streaming in Japan at 11:30 p.m. on the same day as the main broadcast.

Prime Video is the first officially announced streaming service in Japan. International platform availability can differ by territory, so AniNextUp will update this guide when additional distributors confirm their schedules.

Nagi Taira was once a powerful assassin. After protecting his sister Shizuka from gunfire, he remains unresponsive until murderous intent is directed toward him. Shizuka begins taking her brother into battles against increasingly dangerous enemies in an attempt to fully awaken him.
Tokyo Revengers is back with the War of the Three Titans arc, airing weekly from October 2.

Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans began October 2, 2026. MBS and TBS air new episodes every Friday at 1:23 a.m. JST, while CBC, BS-TBS, AT-X and numerous regional Japanese stations carry the arc on their own schedules.

The official anime site confirms Disney+ as the worldwide subscription streaming home outside mainland China. New episodes begin streaming Fridays at 2:00 a.m. JST, shortly after the earliest Japanese broadcast.

The new arc continues Takemichi Hanagaki's time-leap story after the Tenjiku conflict and brings the struggle surrounding Mikey into a new phase. Promotional material introduces major players including Takeomi Akashi, Wakasa Imaushi, Keizo Arashi and South Terano.
JO1 performs the opening theme “IGNITE,” while go!go!vanillas performs the ending theme “Trickster.” Both songs were announced by the anime's official site ahead of the October broadcast.

War of the Three Titans is a continuation of Tokyo Revengers, not a standalone reboot. It follows the events of the Tenjiku conflict and moves Takemichi's story into the next major struggle surrounding Mikey and the new factions competing for power. New viewers will get much more from this arc after watching the earlier Tokyo Revengers seasons and arcs.
It is the next major anime arc in the continuing Tokyo Revengers story.
Yes. This arc continues the existing story and assumes familiarity with Takemichi, Mikey and the events leading out of the Tenjiku conflict.
Yes. The official anime site lists Disney+ for worldwide subscription streaming outside mainland China, with new episodes beginning Fridays at 2:00 a.m. JST.
The announced schedule is weekly on Fridays, although the displayed day and time can shift by territory because of time-zone differences.
Latest update: October 5, 2026 · Streaming and broadcast information checked against the official Tokyo Revengers site.
The arc is scheduled as a weekly Friday release. Broadcast times can differ across Japan, and Disney+ availability can display differently according to local time zones outside Japan.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is set to premiere in Japan on October 11, with a special advance screening at New York Comic Con on October 8.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus premieres in Japan on October 11, 2026, at 11:15 p.m. Japan Standard Time. The official Dragon Ball pre-broadcast guide published October 9 confirms the broadcast time and the first Japanese streaming services. This is the ENHANCED edition of Dragon Ball Super, with newly added and redrawn footage and a reconstructed narrative, according to the official New York Comic Con report.

The Japanese premiere is scheduled for Sunday, October 11 at 11:15 p.m. JST. The first episode was screened in advance at New York Comic Con on October 8. The official report says the screening drew a crowd of approximately 3,000 attendees, with English dub cast members Jason Douglas (Beerus) and Ian Sinclair (Whis) taking part in the panel. This screening was a preview event, not a public streaming launch.
Akira Toriyama is credited for the original work, story and character design. The announced opening theme is “ONOGAMI” by MEGATERA・ZERO, while VK Blanka performs the ending theme.

Japan: The official October 9 guide lists Prime Video and U-NEXT as the fastest streaming options, starting October 12 at 12:15 a.m. JST, after the October 11 television broadcast. Other Japanese streaming services are scheduled to follow.

Outside Japan: Crunchyroll's Fall 2026 lineup lists the series for supported international territories, but the October 9 official Dragon Ball report says North American streaming platforms and timing will be announced separately. These statements are not fully aligned. We therefore do not treat an October 11 Crunchyroll launch time in North America as independently settled. Check the regional service schedule for final confirmation.

The new official update adds an exact Japanese broadcast time, named Japanese streaming platforms and the first on-demand availability window. It also makes the international timing caveat important: a Japanese broadcast date does not guarantee simultaneous streaming in every region. The October 8 New York Comic Con screening confirms that Episode 1 has already received a preview, but does not establish a general release time outside Japan.
Night City returns with a new crew. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 premieres globally on Netflix on October 20.

Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 premieres globally on Netflix on October 20, 2026. CD PROJEKT RED and TRIGGER return to Night City, but this is a new standalone installment rather than a direct continuation of David's story.
The new series is confirmed for 10 episodes. Netflix describes it as a self-contained story of redemption and revenge with an entirely new crew of mercenaries and a reimagined animation style.

Weak, a former cyberpunk legend, has to find a new purpose while living without chrome. At the same time, nomad D follows a path of revenge that draws her toward corporate secrets. Their stories become intertwined across Night City.

CD PROJEKT RED and animation studio TRIGGER reunite for the project. Kai Ikarashi directs, Kanno Ichigo serves as lead character designer, and Bartosz Sztybor and Masahiko Otsuka are among the returning creative leads.
Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 streams exclusively on Netflix beginning October 20.
I'm Looking For a Zombie premieres October 3, 2026 on Crunchyroll. Release date, studio and streaming details for Fall 2026.
I'm Looking For a Zombie premieres October 3, 2026. Crunchyroll begins streaming the series alongside its Japanese release, with the first English-dubbed episode also launching the same day.

Crunchyroll lists availability across North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS and India. Exact release times and language options can differ by territory.

The series follows Aki and her friends through a city devastated by zombies. Instead of simply trying to escape, the group sets out to search for Aki's missing father, turning the ruined city into the setting for both a survival story and a personal journey.
Yes. Crunchyroll confirmed a same-day English dub. Madeline Dorroh voices Aki, with Arianna Contardo as Natsuki, Blythe Melin as Haru, Giselle Fernandez as Yu and Anairis Quiñones as Sakura.
studio COMET handles the animation. AniNextUp will continue tracking weekly release information and any changes to regional availability during the Fall 2026 season.

A Tale of the Secret Saint premieres October 3, 2026 on Crunchyroll. Release date, studio and streaming details for Fall 2026.
A Tale of the Secret Saint premieres October 3, 2026. Crunchyroll carries the series internationally as part of its Fall 2026 lineup.

The announced Crunchyroll territories include North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS, the Indian Subcontinent, Southeast Asia and Korea. Availability and episode timing can still vary by individual market.

The story follows a swordswoman who believes she has little talent until memories of a previous life reveal that she was once a powerful Saint. That knowledge gives her extraordinary magical potential, but openly revealing it would also expose her to enemies connected to her former life.

FelixFilm is the animation studio for the adaptation. The series combines fantasy adventure with a reincarnation mystery built around the heroine hiding abilities that could completely change how others see her.
Rather than starting with a hero who understands her powers, the central conflict comes from remembering a past identity and deciding how much of that strength can safely be used in the present.
See the Fall 2026 anime calendar for other confirmed October premieres.
Romelia War Chronicle premieres October 3, 2026 on Crunchyroll. Release date, studio and streaming details for Fall 2026.
Romelia War Chronicle premieres October 3, 2026. The production is planned as a two-cour television anime, giving the postwar story more room than a single short seasonal run.
Crunchyroll carries the anime in announced territories including North America, Central and South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East and CIS. Regional release timing may vary.

Romelia helped Prince Henri defeat Demon King Zelgis, only for Henri to end their engagement after the victory. Instead of treating the Demon King's defeat as the end of the story, Romelia returns to a homeland still devastated by war and decides to rebuild it herself.

Her work includes organizing an army, restoring the economy and confronting political conspiracies. The premise therefore focuses on what happens after the traditional fantasy victory, when a country still has to recover from the damage left behind.

Animation studio Atra produces the series. Koji Saito serves as series director, Aya Satsuki handles series composition and scripts, and KOHTA YAMAMOTO composes the music. Yuna Nemoto voices Romelia von Graham.

The official promotional campaign describes the series as a postwar saga about a discarded noblewoman building a new future. AniNextUp will track the two-cour schedule as additional episode and streaming information is announced.

Aoashi Season 2 premieres October 4, 2026 on Crunchyroll. Release date, studio and streaming details for Fall 2026.
Aoashi Season 2 is scheduled for October 4, 2026. The announced streaming platform is Crunchyroll.

In Japan, subscription streaming begins October 4 at 11:00 p.m. JST on Hulu, Netflix, U-NEXT and Anime Times, with additional Japanese services beginning October 8. International availability can follow a different schedule by territory.
Aoi Ashito joins the elite A team and faces a much harsher level of competition.

Crunchyroll has announced Season 2 for international regions including North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS, India and Southeast Asia. Japanese streaming includes Hulu, Netflix, U-NEXT and Anime Times from October 4.
Also premiering October 4: TANK CHAIR and Blue Box Season 2. Coming October 5: PSYREN.
